connector.name: Desktop Touch MCP
connector.registryDescription: Computer-use MCP for Windows 10/11: 32 tools - screenshot, UIA, Chrome CDP, type/click/scroll, VBA.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package desktop-touch-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the harusame64 account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_AUTO_GUARD
env.description: Set to '0' to disable automatic action guards (reverts to v0.11.12 behavior).

env.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_PERCEPTION_RESOURCES
env.description: Set to '1' to enable MCP perception resources.

env.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_PERCEPTION_IDLE_MS
env.description: Idle ms before the WinEvent sidecar enters dormancy (default 60000).

env.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_PERCEPTION_DORMANCY_DISABLE
env.description: Set to '1' to keep the WinEvent sidecar always running (no auto-dormancy).

env.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG_DISABLE
env.description: Set to '1' to disable the JSONL diagnostic event log (issue #365 Phase 2).

env.name: DESKTOP_TOUCH_DIAGNOSTIC_LOG_PATH
env.description: Override path for the diagnostic event log.
